svg.title: Transverse probability densities and longitudinal subbands
svg.desc: Panel a shows the first three energy-ordered hard-wall modes n=1,2,3, corresponding to (ny,nz)=(1,1),(2,1),(1,2), in a 10 by 8 nanometre section. Horizontal is y and vertical is z. All density maps share the scale 0 to 4/(W H)=0.05 per square nanometre and integrate to one. Panel b plots the associated parabolic dispersions, using blue, gold, and red consistently for modes one, two, and three. Their edges are 50.7,110.1,143.5 meV for mass 0.19 m0. Legends are outside the curves.
